gaps.lead: They left the party early because it was boring.
gaps.sentence: The party was ___ that they left early.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective + that-clause: so boring that they left.

gaps.lead: It isn't necessary for you to bring any food.
gaps.explanation: needn't (need not) = it isn't necessary. Do not confuse with mustn't (prohibition).

gaps.lead: The painter worked for three weeks on the mural.
gaps.explanation: spend + time + -ing: spent over three weeks (working on it).

gaps.lead: The plane had just taken off when the warning light appeared.
gaps.sentence: The plane had ___ when the warning light appeared.
gaps.explanation: had just + participle = a very short time before.

gaps.lead: 'You've stolen my idea!' he said to her.
Someone should test this water regularly.
gaps.explanation: should test → should be tested (modal + be + participle).
